answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks using multi-station radio direction finding. Verifier antenna arrays issue a nonce and measure carrier-phase angles of arrival on each signed reply, collapsing co-located clones. Scaling identities requires separate physical transmitters across wide terrain, even a remote tundra, imposing real hardware and siting costs per node. Yet multipath scatter or a signal fading like a dying ember in noise can skew phase estimates and block honest agents.
